title: Talent pulse notes — morning triage and quick follow-ups
body:
Quick morning brain dump + checklist — Monica (junior coord block)

Overview / mood: juggling 6 active reqs today, heavy on afternoon panels. Need to clear a few follow-ups and lock two reschedules before EOD. Keep replies short, copy-swap template lines to save time.

Top priorities (must-dos before lunch):
- Confirm 1pm PT panel for SDE candidate (A. Nguyen) — need final confirmation from hiring manager (Rae) and backend interviewer (Jamal). If no reply by 11:30am PT, bubble to Rae in Slack.
- Send offer logistics checklist to Hired Sales candidate (Maya) — comp band question (see note below).
- Reschedule UX take-home review: candidate L. Park asked to move due to laptop issue; propose new window Wed 9–11am PT and Fri 2–4pm PT.

Time-blocking (rough):
- 8:30–9:15am: inbox triage (candidate replies, recruiter escalations)
- 9:15–10:00am: update calendars + create meeting invites for confirmed panels
- 10:00–11:30am: phone screens (x2) + quick debrief notes in Greenhouse
- 11:30–12:00pm: follow-up nudges (no-reply panels)
- 1:00–4:00pm: panels and buffer for reschedules
- 4:00–4:30pm: daily roundup and send candidate status update to Hiring Manager (Rae)

Candidates to follow up (short notes):
- A. Nguyen (SDE) — panel 1pm PT pending: emailed hiring manager at 9:02am; no response. Call manager if still pending by 11:30am PT. Candidate is flexible M–F afternoons.
- Maya R. (Sales) — asked about comp range yesterday. Send TL;DR template: "band 3, target 110–125k + quota accelerators. Will confirm exact on offer." Keep tone friendly.
- L. Park (Product Designer) — request to extend take-home due to laptop crash. Offer two alternate windows; preference Wed morning. Mark as "in progress" in Greenhouse.
- Chris O. (SRE) — awaiting coding exercise submission (reminder scheduled for 3 days after invite). Today is day 5, nudge now (template below).
- S. Gupta (PM) — panel feedback collected; hiring manager wants second EIC call before decision. Schedule for next Tue morning PST.

Templates (short) — use when sending quick nudges:
- Panel confirmation nudge: "Hi [Name], quick check — are you good to interview A. Nguyen at 1:00pm PT today? We need to confirm to send candidate the final schedule. Thanks! — Monica"
- Candidate exercise nudge: "Hey [Name], hope you’re well — just checking in on the coding exercise for Redwood SRE. If you need more time, let me know; otherwise we’d appreciate an ETA this week. Cheers."

Notes to self / pitfalls to watch:
- Timezones: hiring manager Rae often drops TZ confusion — always add timezone to invite text (e.g., 1:00pm PT / 4:00pm ET).
- Panel overbook risk: multiple panels for SDE are back-to-back; leave 15m buffer for tech screeners.
- Watch for double-booking across calendars — DevInfra and Platform Eng share several interviewers (S. Kim and Jamal).

Open questions / unblockers:
- Need final comp approval for Sales candidate from Finance (ticket REC-447) — ping Sarai in finance by 10am PT.
- Is there an available conference room for in-person final loop on Fri? Ops said "maybe" — follow up with office-ops.

End-of-day deliverables (send before 5pm):
- Daily candidate status summary to Rae + attached short notes for panels (1 paragraph per candidate)
- Confirmed calendar invites for any rescheduled slots
- Update Greenhouse statuses on 4 candidates (A. Nguyen: panel-scheduled; Maya R: offer-discussion; L. Park: take-home extended; Chris O: reminded)

Random micro-tasks (if time):
- Trim subject lines on invites to reduce clutter (use "Interview: A. Nguyen — SDE — 1pm PT")
- Save canned messages into Slack snippet for recurring nudges

Snippets / canned lines to copy-paste:
- "Thanks for the update! We’ll follow up after the panel. —Monica"
- "Quick note: please use the attached calendar link to join (Zoom link is in invite)."

Backlog items (not urgent):
- Build a one-pager for candidates about the remote interview loop (short bulleted set). Good to finish next week.
- Review and prune interview slot templates — some slots are rarely used, tighten to zones.

Last-minute: Jamal confirmed for 12:50pm PT (just saw his reply). Move panel to 1:05pm PT to give buffer. Update candidate text: short apology and new start time (1:05pm PT).

— end of quick notes —

(append: short log of actions taken)
- 09:03am: nudged Rae in slack for A. Nguyen
- 09:12am: sent comp-band note to Maya R. (cc: finance request)
summary: Personal scratchpad for recruiting coordinator: triage, scheduling, candidate follow-ups, and quick templates
